text.arabic_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا

words.gloss_range: independent third-person pronoun foregrounding the divine subject or framing the following matter
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) begins with an explicit divine subject before any event is named. It turns the ayah from a mere report of sending into an identifying proclamation, while also carrying the possible matter-pronoun feel in which the whole following mission is the disclosed matter. Coming after 48:27, the formerly implicit divine arranger is made overt, and the address widens from local second-person promise into third-person universal declaration.

topics.headline: explicit divine subject before the event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by identifying the divine agent before narrating the sending.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as the mubtada of a nominal sentence, so the CRITICAL claim that explicit subject placement foregrounds identity is locally supported.

topics.headline: referential pronoun with matter-framing possibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opener can point to God directly while also giving the following assertion the feel of a disclosed matter.
topics.reason: The local syntax strongly licenses the referential subject reading; the matter-pronoun nuance is kept only as a framing possibility, not as a replacement for the divine referent.

topics.headline: boundary turns implicit agency into proclamation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 48:28 continues the prior divine agency while changing the register from addressed promise to public declaration.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the explicit pronoun and the shift from 48:27's addressed sequence to this nominal proclamation.

words.gloss_range: masculine singular relative pronoun carrying the predicate through the following relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِىٓ}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes the predicate a definite relative description: the divine subject is identified by the act and mission that follow. The construction has restrictive, cleft-like force, centering agency in this sender rather than an impersonal source. Its written length and opening liaison give the identifying link audible weight before the heavier lexical roots begin.

topics.headline: relative clause carries the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission sequence is packaged as the identifying predicate of the opening pronoun.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun opens the syntactically forced ṣila, so the following sending, instruments, purpose, and scope function as the predicate of the opener.

topics.headline: cleft-like restriction of agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is directed to the divine referent before the sending verb appears.
topics.reason: The huwa-alladhī frame supports the CRITICAL claim that the construction restricts and centers agency.

topics.headline: recited onset binds pronoun and relative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening link is not only syntactic but also delayed and smoothed in recitation before the verb enters.
topics.reason: The surface form and immediate adjacency allow the sound-form payoff without making it control the grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect dispatching, locally selected as authorized sending of the messenger
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes sending, releasing, flowing, and dispatch; here the messenger object selects delegated dispatch while preserving release-into-movement color
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلَ}} ({{tr:arsala}}) is a completed Form IV sending: the commissioning itself is presented as accomplished, while the purpose that follows remains to be realized. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) field gives the dispatch a release-into-movement texture, narrowed here by the direct object into authorized mission-sending. The verb is delayed until after the pronoun-relative frame, then immediately mirrors the same root in the messenger noun. That cognate pairing makes the act and the sent-one define each other, and the shared mission formula with 9:33 and 61:9 makes the later coda difference visible.

topics.headline: perfect Form IV completed sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission is grounded in an accomplished divine dispatch, not a hypothetical commissioning.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV perfect verb with the messenger as object, supporting both completed aspect and causative authorized dispatch.

topics.headline: release-flow root narrowed to authorized mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending is not bare transfer; it carries a concrete sense of release into movement under delegated authority.
topics.reason: The wider release and flow range is real background, but the local object rasūlahū selects authorized dispatch rather than animals, water, or sails.

topics.headline: mission formula shared with 9:33 and 61:9
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first clause enters a known mission formula (9:33; 61:9), so 48:28's witness ending becomes the distinctive local specialization.
topics.reason: The explicit parallels to 9:33 and 61:9 support retaining the formulaic echo and the coda-divergence payoff.

topics.headline: verb and messenger repeat the same root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger is grammatically and sonically constituted as the sent-one by the sending verb itself.
topics.reason: The repeated root across verb and object is visible in the aligned forms and supports the etymological figure.

topics.headline: event delayed inside identity frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending enters only after agency is framed, with sound and surah-local recurrence reinforcing the sent-one identity.
topics.reason: The word order, consonant repetition, and local cross-references cohere with the identity-first reading without changing the verb's local sense.

words.gloss_range: accusative messenger noun with possessive suffix, the sent envoy belonging to the divine sender
words.root_gloss_range: root field of sending, messengerhood, and carried message; here the noun names the delegated envoy whose role is defined by being sent
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولَهُۥ}} ({{tr:rasūlahū}}) is the direct object of the sending and the possessive suffix binds the envoy back to the sender. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) noun does not describe a traveler by accident; its agentive shape and risāla pressure make messengerhood a durable delegated role with carried content. The local cognate phrase lets the sent-one embody the sending itself, while the boundary from 48:27 keeps the same messenger continuous under a larger mission frame.

topics.headline: messenger as possessed object of sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger is not autonomous; grammar routes his mission and authority back to the sender.
topics.reason: The accusative object relation and attached possessive suffix directly support delegated, sender-bound messengerhood.

topics.headline: rasūl as durable envoy with message
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names a stable envoy role carrying mission content, not a one-time movement.
topics.reason: The lexical and form evidence supports messenger as a durable agentive role from the r-s-l family.

topics.headline: sent-one embodies the sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action-person echo: the sending becomes embodied in the messenger named by the same root.
topics.reason: The local verb and object share the same root, making the cognate-object payoff locally visible.

topics.headline: same messenger enters universal mission frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger certified near 48:27 is not replaced; the same delegated figure is reframed with universal mission content.
topics.reason: The boundary and surah-local rows preserve continuity of referent while the attached suffix keeps the envoy bound to the divine sender.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the guidance phrase, with accompaniment, instrument, and cause remaining locally available
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) attaches guidance directly to the sending. Its local force keeps accompaniment and instrument both live: the messenger is sent with guidance, and guidance is also the means through which the mission operates. Its proclitic surface makes that attachment visible and audible. Because the governed phrase extends through the coordinated truth-system, the particle binds both mission contents to the sending instead of letting them float as afterthoughts.

topics.headline: bāʾ keeps with and by active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is both carried with the messenger and functions as the mission's operating means.
topics.reason: The bāʾ governs the guidance phrase, and QAC explicitly permits accompaniment, instrument, or cause depending on reading.

topics.headline: proclitic governance binds the mission contents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle's written and recited attachment makes guidance and the truth-system one governed mission unit.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the preposition governing guidance and, through coordination, the truth-system; the proclitic form reinforces that dependency.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun for guidance/right direction, governed by bāʾ as carried mission orientation
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes guiding, leading along a path, gift, and led offering; here guidance/right direction is selected while concrete leading and bestowal remain color
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) is not a free-standing doctrine word; under the bāʾ it is attached to the sending as the mission's carried orientation and instrument. The {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) range gives this guidance path-leading and bestowed-gift pressure, narrowed locally to right direction rather than the sacrificial-animal branch. Its definite maṣdar form turns guiding into something the messenger bears, and its recurrence in 9:33 and 61:9 marks it as the fixed instrument in the mission formula. The softer h-d-y sound also marks a gentler turn from dispatch into orientation.

topics.headline: guidance attached to the sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is built into the sending as accompaniment and means, not appended as a separate abstraction.
topics.reason: The bāʾ-governed genitive form ties the word directly to the sending verb.

topics.headline: path-leading and gift pressure within guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as enacted orientation that leads forward and is bestowed, not merely a list of propositions.
topics.reason: The broader h-d-y branches color the word, while the local maṣdar under bāʾ selects guidance/right direction rather than every root branch.

topics.headline: definite maṣdar reifies guiding as carried instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of guiding is made into a definite, bounded mission-instrument the messenger carries.
topics.reason: The QAC form tag and noun shape support the CRITICAL distinction between finite guiding and nominalized guidance.

topics.headline: guidance is fixed in the parallel mission formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is the stable formulaic instrument across 9:33, 48:28, and 61:9, while each verse's ending specializes the formula.
topics.reason: The concrete references to 9:33 and 61:9, plus the local surah h-d-y thread (48:2; 48:20; 48:25), support the formulaic and surah-local payoff.

topics.headline: soft sound suits directional orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a softer acoustic turn as the phrase moves from dispatch into guidance as orientation.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is locally tied to the word's sound and is kept as a small reader-facing payoff.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining or clarifying the second governed mission content
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the hinge between guidance and the truth-system. It can be heard as coordination, giving the mission two companion instruments, or as clarification, letting the truth-system specify the guidance. The bound form and audible reset keep the second phrase connected to the bāʾ-governed sequence while preventing guidance and dīn from collapsing silently into one undifferentiated term.

topics.headline: coordination and clarification remain plausible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission may carry two companion contents or one content clarified by the second phrase.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence strongly licenses coordination under the bāʾ; appositional clarification is retained as a semantic possibility rather than the sole parse.

topics.headline: conjunction keeps the two contents distinguishable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a visible and audible joint where abstract guidance and systematic dīn are paired without being swallowed into each other.
topics.reason: The proclitic conjunction and syntactic coordination support a real local distinction between the two governed nouns.

words.gloss_range: construct-state dīn governed by the earlier bāʾ and defined by the following truth term
words.root_gloss_range: root field spans religion, obedience, debt, reckoning, judgment, and ordered submission; here it names a truth-defined accountability system
words.prose: {{ar:دِينِ}} ({{tr:dīni}}) inherits the earlier bāʾ-governance, so it is a second mission content attached to the sending. In construct with the truth term, it is not defined by institution or adherents but by truth itself. The {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) field keeps religion, debt, reckoning, obligation, and ordered submission in view, narrowed locally into a truth-defined accountability system. Its first occurrence also prepares the internal contrast with the later generic dīn over which manifestation is made.

topics.headline: dīn remains under the earlier bāʾ
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the truth-system is part of what the messenger is sent with, not a detached nominative claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows dīn sharing bāʾ-governance through coordination.

topics.headline: construct state defines dīn by truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the system's identity depends on truth as its genitive anchor.
topics.reason: The iḍāfa relation is syntactically forced, making the truth term the local definition of the construct head.

topics.headline: religion-debt-reckoning field narrowed to system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dīn as a binding accountability order, not merely an abstract creed label.
topics.reason: The lexical range is valid, but local grammar selects the system sense rather than activating every branch independently.

topics.headline: truth-system contrasts with later generic dīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first dīn names the truth-defined system, while the later dīn names the whole field it will be manifested over.
topics.reason: The repeated d-y-n root in two different constructions supports the internal contrast and the mission-formula designation.

topics.headline: noun form turns owing and submission into system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that acts of owing, judging, submitting, and reckoning are condensed into a named system.
topics.reason: The noun form licenses the system payoff while the local construct prevents it from becoming vague polysemy.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive truth/right term defining the construct dīn
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes truth, reality, right, due claim, and verification; here it defines the system as reality-aligned and obligation-bearing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) is locked as the genitive complement of the preceding dīn, so truth is not a separate object of sending but the standard that defines the system. The {{ar:ح ق ق}} ({{tr:ḥ-q-q}}) range joins truth, reality, right, and what is due, making the phrase both epistemic and moral. Its definite substantive form presents truth as a determinate standard, and the boundary from 48:27 shifts the same truth root from validating a vision to naming the mission's defining content.

topics.headline: truth locked to dīn as genitive anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth defines the system from within the construct phrase rather than standing as a separate sent object.
topics.reason: The syntactically forced iḍāfa and genitive case support the local binding to dīn.

topics.headline: truth and what-is-due define the phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission's system is reality-aligned and obligation-bearing at once.
topics.reason: The root range supports truth, right, and due claim, while local genitive construction selects these as definitional pressures for dīn.

topics.headline: divine-name pressure without replacing the genitive sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth can carry divine-standard resonance while still functioning locally as the genitive quality of the system.
topics.reason: The divine-name association is retained as pressure, but the local word remains a genitive complement defining dīn.

topics.headline: truth moves from warrant to mission content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the truth root repeated from 48:27 changes role: from warranting the vision to defining the mission's system.
topics.reason: The concrete boundary rows supply 48:27 as the prior reference, and the local iḍāfa shows the changed role.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām bound to the following subjunctive imperfect
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) pivots the ayah from what the messenger is sent with to what the sending is for. As purpose lām, it governs the following imperfect and makes manifestation the goal of the completed dispatch. Because it is bound directly to the verb, teleology is not a loose explanation but an immediate grammatical continuation of the mission architecture.

topics.headline: purpose lām makes manifestation the goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending is teleological: it is aimed at manifestation, not merely delivery.
topics.reason: The purpose clause is syntactically forced, and QAC identifies the lām as requiring the subjunctive verb that follows.

topics.headline: particle turns instruments into purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact hinge from mission contents to mission outcome.
topics.reason: The bound lām sits after the governed instruments and before the purpose verb, making the pivot locally visible.

words.gloss_range: Form IV subjunctive purpose verb, to make it manifest or prevail, with object suffix most locally referring to the truth-system
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes appearing, outward surface or back, manifestation, support, and prevailing; here Form IV selects causing manifestation or prevalence
words.prose: {{ar:يُظْهِرَهُۥ}} ({{tr:yuẓhirahū}}) is the governed purpose verb: the completed sending aims at an ongoing result. The object suffix can generate several routes, but local cross-reference most strongly points to the truth-defined dīn, while the messenger or guidance routes remain secondary readings. The {{ar:ظ ه ر}} ({{tr:ẓ-h-r}}) field keeps visibility and ascendancy together: the purpose is to bring the truth-system outward and make it prevail. Form IV makes that result caused by the divine sender, not an object appearing on its own, and the formulaic links to 9:33 and 61:9 plus the manifestation-witness echo with 7:172 make the purpose clause more than local mechanics.

topics.headline: subjunctive purpose verb links dispatch to result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose verb completes the mission architecture by tying accomplished sending to intended manifestation.
topics.reason: The preceding lām syntactically governs the imperfect verb, and the purpose clause completes the sending frame.

topics.headline: suffix most strongly resumes the truth-system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact suffix carries the object of manifestation, with dīn al-ḥaqq as the strongest local antecedent and other routes only secondary.
topics.reason: The bundle's cross-reference marks the suffix as strongly resuming dīni l-ḥaqq, so the triple ambiguity is preserved only as a possible semantic route.

topics.headline: visibility and prevail are both active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose is not bare domination or bare display; truth is brought outward where it can be seen and made ascendant.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports both manifestation and prevailing, while local Form IV purpose selects causative outward manifestation over all root branches.

topics.headline: Form IV assigns causation to the divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is made manifest by divine agency rather than simply appearing by itself.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV, so the contrast with intransitive appearing is a valid form-specific payoff.

topics.headline: mission formula and 7:172 connect manifestation with witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose verb belongs to the shared mission formula (9:33; 61:9) and also resonates with witness language through 7:172.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references to 9:33, 61:9, and 7:172, so the echo is retained without making it govern the local parse.

topics.headline: near opening expands toward total manifestation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 48:27's near opening is redirected toward a larger manifestation, with the emphatic sound giving the purpose verb weight.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and local sound observation add a limited but concrete payoff around the purpose verb.

words.gloss_range: preposition of overness/superiority governing the total dīn phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) frames manifestation as overness rather than mere coexistence. It governs the whole target phrase, including the totalizer, so the scope is built into the prepositional relation. The over, upon, and against senses mutually reinforce a vertical and adversarial relation: the truth-system is made manifest over the entire dīn field, not simply discussed alongside it. The open-vowel expansion after the emphatic purpose verb gives that reach an audible widening.

topics.headline: ʿalā selects overness and superiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose clause imagines manifestation as over and against the field, not merely within it.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the target dīn phrase and locally selects an overness relation.

topics.headline: preposition scopes over dīn and its totalizer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality belongs inside the governed target phrase rather than arriving as a detached rhetorical flourish.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows al-dīn governed by ʿalā and kullihī intensifying that same governed phrase.

topics.headline: vowel expansion mirrors reach over the field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase opening acoustically as manifestation reaches over the target field.
topics.reason: The acoustic observation remains a minor local payoff and does not alter the preposition's syntactic role.

words.gloss_range: definite generic dīn governed by ʿalā as the total target field
words.root_gloss_range: root field spans religion, debt, judgment, reckoning, and submission; here it names the generic field of accountability systems
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:al-dīni}}) is not the same construction as the earlier construct dīn. With the article and under ʿalā, it names the generic category, the whole field of accountability or submission systems over which manifestation occurs. The following totalizer locks onto this word, so the scope is universal rather than sectarian. The repeated {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) root creates the ayah's internal comparison: the truth-defined system is made manifest over the total field of systems.

topics.headline: definite generic dīn is the target field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is the universal category of dīn, not one named opponent or co-instrument.
topics.reason: The word is article-marked, genitive under ʿalā, and contextually generic.

topics.headline: kullihī intensifies this exact dīn category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following totality is grammatically anchored to this target field.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks kullihī as intensifying al-dīn, so totality does not float independently.

topics.headline: d-y-n range applied to competing systems
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the competing field as accountability or submission structures, not only religions in a thin label sense.
topics.reason: The same lexical field is relevant, but the article and ʿalā phrase select the generic target field rather than the truth-defined construct.

topics.headline: construct dīn contrasts with generic al-dīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root first names the true system and then the whole field over which that system is manifested.
topics.reason: The two local dīn forms differ in construction, and the repeated root supports the internal contrast.

words.gloss_range: emphatic totalizer with suffix referring back to the generic dīn field
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes allness, completeness, encircling edge, and exhaustion; here it intensifies the entire dīn category with no remainder
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّهِۦ}} ({{tr:kullihī}}) closes the purpose clause by forcing total scope. Its suffix binds the allness back to the generic dīn field, so the word does not mean abstract totality but the entirety of that category. The {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) range adds completeness and encircling no-remainder pressure, while the singular form compactly totalizes the collective field. Coming after the near opening of 48:27 and before the witness coda, it expands the horizon to universal mission scope.

topics.headline: kullihī blocks partial scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose claim excludes a partial reading: manifestation is over the whole dīn field.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as intensifying al-dīn with pronominal dependency.

topics.headline: completion and encircling pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices totality as encircling exhaustion of the specific category, not vague abundance.
topics.reason: The broader root image is narrowed by the suffix and antecedent to complete scope over al-dīn.

topics.headline: purpose clause lands on total scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word before the coda is scope maximization, making totality the launch point for witness sufficiency.
topics.reason: The word closes the purpose clause, and collocation evidence places totality inside the mission formula.

topics.headline: near opening expands to universal scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from 48:27's near opening into a universal mission horizon.
topics.reason: The concrete references to 48:21, 48:26, and 48:27 support the local totality progression without changing the word's grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the independent sufficiency coda while preserving linkage
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the hinge after total scope. It opens a new sufficiency clause while still binding the coda to the mission statement, so the ayah pivots from sending and universal manifestation to divine witness sufficiency. The ambiguity between resumption and coordination keeps the coda independent as attestation yet linked to the opening identification. The short bound clitic also resets the cadence after totality. In comparison with 9:33 and 61:9, this is the point where 48:28 replaces the resistance ending with a witness ending.

topics.headline: wāw opens a linked independent coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coda is both a new attestation clause and still linked to the opening identity frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the clause as an independent sufficiency formula; coordination is retained only as a linkage possibility within the broader identification.

topics.headline: mission turns into witness seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact structural pivot from mission scope to the witness who guarantees it.
topics.reason: The word divides the ayah into the relative-purpose unit and the sufficiency coda.

topics.headline: 48:28 diverges from 9:33 and 61:9 at the coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shared mission body (9:33; 61:9) is locally specialized by ending on divine witness rather than human dislike.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels 9:33 and 61:9 make this coda a meaningful variant pressure point.

topics.headline: bound clitic resets cadence into coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a short audible restart after totality, even as the clitic remains bound to the following verb.
topics.reason: The bound surface form and cadence observation support a small sound-level payoff tied to the structural pivot.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect sufficiency verb in the idiom kafā bi-X Y-an
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes being enough, adequacy, sufficing, protecting, defending, and averting; here sufficiency is selected with protective adequacy as color
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَىٰ}} ({{tr:kafā}}) states sufficiency as already established. In the idiom, the following bāʾ-marked divine name is logically the subject, so the phrase is not ordinary instrumental syntax. The {{ar:ك ف ي}} ({{tr:k-f-y}}) range makes sufficiency complete enough to exclude added validators, with protection and averting harm coloring that adequacy. As a fixed witness formula also found in 4:79, it seals the universal mission claim on God's sufficient witness rather than on human acceptance, and it turns the total scope just stated into sufficient attestation. Its coda cadence slows from totalizing scope into the witness landing.

topics.headline: perfect kafā declares established sufficiency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine sufficiency is stated as accomplished, not wished for or requested.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I perfect, supporting accomplished sufficiency rather than seeking sufficiency.

topics.headline: marked bāʾ frame gives subject force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prepositional-looking phrase carries logical subject force inside a fixed sufficiency idiom.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the coda as the kafā bi-X Y-an formula with a zāʾida bāʾ.

topics.headline: sufficiency excludes supplemental validators
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices sufficiency as complete adequacy that removes the need for other witnesses or safeguards.
topics.reason: The protection and averting-harm branches color the selected sufficiency sense without replacing it.

topics.headline: 4:79 repeats the witness-sufficiency formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the coda as a recurring answer to messenger-sending: God suffices as witness (4:79).
topics.reason: The exact reference to 4:79 supports the formulaic sending-plus-witness connection.

topics.headline: sufficiency seals universal mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal manifestation is warranted by divine witness sufficiency rather than human acceptance.
topics.reason: The coda follows the totality phrase and functions as the attesting seal of the mission claim.

topics.headline: scope totality turns into audible attestation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from totalizing scope to a slowed witness landing in the coda's sound.
topics.reason: The k-l-l progression (48:21; 48:26) and coda cadence are retained as secondary payoffs around the sufficiency seal.

words.gloss_range: pleonastic bāʾ in the kafā idiom, visible in form but not ordinary instrumental meaning
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is the idiomatic bāʾ of the kafā construction. It is present and governs the divine name on the surface, but it does not mean ordinary by or with; it marks the logical subject inside the sufficiency formula. Its proclitic fusion makes the closing phrase compact and recognizable, binding sufficiency directly to the divine name in sound as well as grammar.

topics.headline: zāʾida bāʾ marks logical subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension between visible preposition and cancelled ordinary prepositional meaning in the sufficiency idiom.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly marks this bāʾ as zāʾida in the kafā idiom, with Allāh as logical subject.

topics.headline: proclitic bāʾ binds the formula to the divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bāʾ makes the coda a compact, familiar formula rather than a freshly assembled phrase.
topics.reason: The proclitic written and recited attachment reinforces the formulaic shape without adding ordinary instrumental semantics.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name, genitive in surface form after zāʾida bāʾ but logical subject of sufficiency
words.root_gloss_range: root and name field includes divinity, worship, and devotion; here the proper divine name supplies singular authority as sufficient witness
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is genitive in surface case after the bāʾ, yet the kafā idiom makes the named God the real sufficing subject. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) background preserves divinity, worship, and devotion pressure, narrowed here to the proper divine name rather than a generic deity. As the last substantive name before the witness role, it gathers the ayah's arc from divine pronoun and sender to explicit divine authority as sufficient witness. The doubled-lām sound compresses that authority at the center of the coda.

topics.headline: genitive form but logical subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that surface case and logical role deliberately diverge in the idiom.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the bāʾ as zāʾida while preserving surface genitive government.

topics.headline: proper divine name, not generic deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that witness sufficiency rests in the proper divine name, not an interchangeable title or generic deity.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is retained as background pressure, while the local form is the proper name Allāh.

topics.headline: divine name links sender and sufficient witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from God's pronoun and sending to God's own name as the final authority before witness.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and position rows show the divine name sitting at the intersection of sending and witness in the coda.

topics.headline: surah-local authority gathered into compressed name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dense surah-local divine authority concentrated in the coda's weighty divine-name sound.
topics.reason: The recurrence of the divine name in Surah 48 and the local doubled-lām sound support a secondary payoff.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative role specification after kafā, specifying sufficiency as witness
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes presence, seeing, witnessing, testimony, witnessed scene, and visible world; here it specifies God's sufficiency as intensive witness
words.prose: {{ar:شَهِيدًۭا}} ({{tr:shahīdan}}) specifies the capacity in which God suffices: not generic sufficiency, but sufficiency as witness. The indefinite accusative role-name makes the witness capacity the grammatical landing of the idiom. The {{ar:ش ه د}} ({{tr:sh-h-d}}) field keeps presence, seeing, and testimony together, so the witness is not detached certification but full presence to the mission. The faʿīl form intensifies the role, the exact formula recurs in 4:79, and the contrast with the messenger's witness role in 48:8 lets the final word close the surah's mission arc with divine witness-sufficiency. From 48:27's concealed divine knowledge, the boundary arrives at public divine witness, and the final tanwīn gives that witness role its acoustic landing.

topics.headline: accusative specification names the capacity of sufficiency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word specifies sufficiency precisely as witness, not sufficiency in the abstract.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as accusative specification in the kafā construction.

topics.headline: witnessing joins presence, seeing, and testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine witnessing as present, seeing testimony rather than remote certification.
topics.reason: The witness root range is valid, while local syntax selects the witness role in which God suffices.

topics.headline: faʿīl intensifies the witness role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final witness as durable and intensive, not a temporary observer role.
topics.reason: The faʿīl pattern supports intensity; divine-name associations remain resonance, while the local word functions as an accusative role-name.

topics.headline: 4:79 links sending with witness sufficiency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that witness sufficiency is a formulaic answer to messenger-sending, repeated in 4:79.
topics.reason: The exact 4:79 formula and co-occurrence rows connect sh-h-d with sending and sufficiency.

topics.headline: 48:8 messenger witness answered by divine witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a surah-level bookend: the messenger's witness role in 48:8 is answered by God's intensive witness-sufficiency in 48:28.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete 48:8 contrast and the local faʿīl form, supporting the bookend payoff.

topics.headline: final sound and boundary land on witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from concealed divine knowledge in 48:27 to public divine witness at the ayah's final acoustic landing.
topics.reason: The boundary and final-tanwīn observations are locally tied to the last word's role as the closing specification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause built on ظ ه ر and extending over الدين كله.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verb holds disclosure and superiority together, while دين supplies an order of obedience and كل supplies exhaustive scope. The result is not forced to choose between becoming unmistakably visible and becoming ascendant.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment supplies the disclosure pole: the true order is brought into public intelligibility.
Rising over and prevailing supplies the superiority pole without erasing the simultaneous visibility sense.
Obedience and practiced allegiance make the compared field a set of governing orders, not labels alone.
The gathering of every part into a whole gives the claim its deliberately unabridged horizon.

changed_reading.before: The true religion will simply defeat all other religions.
changed_reading.after: The true order is to become wholly exposed as such and to rise over every order of allegiance; manifestation and supremacy remain coexisting senses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ... وكفى بالله شهيدا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A carrier is dispatched with gentle direction; truth is made evident, and the closing witness supplies knowledgeable attestation. The mission therefore has an evidentiary mechanism as well as an expansionary one.

activation_trace.role: A messenger as bearer of carried speech makes transmission, rather than bare force, the initiating mechanism.
Gentle indication toward a path or truth specifies what the bearer transports and how it directs.
Establishing truth by making its evidence apparent links truth directly to the purpose of manifestation.
Knowledgeable declaration closes the mechanism as attestation, not merely as an ornamental divine epithet.
Completing an undertaking until it is sufficient makes divine attestation adequate to the mission's truth claim.

changed_reading.before: The messenger brings a doctrine whose success is later certified by God.
changed_reading.after: The sent carrier bears a gently directing truth whose very manifestation is evidentiary, with divine knowledge completing its attestation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compressed pairing دين الحق and the final witness formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: The account, debt, obligation, proprietary claim, and witness branches assemble a juridical-economic reading: this دين is what is due and what justly adjudicates rival liabilities and loyalties.

activation_trace.role: Accounting, judgment, and recompense turn دين into a governing calculus of what actions incur.
Debt and deferred obligation add the concrete image of a claim that remains outstanding until discharged.
Fixed entitlement and binding necessity characterize the account as genuinely due rather than conventionally asserted.
A right possessed by its claimant makes truth a just claim with relational obligations.
Presence at an event gives the juridical account a competent witness rather than an abstract endorsement.

changed_reading.before: دين الحق means only the religion that possesses correct propositions.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean the binding and just account: a due claim before which every rival calculus of allegiance is exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repetition of دين on both sides of على.
baseline_models.mechanism: The habitual-state branch broadens the comparison beyond named creeds. The truth-order is set over every entrenched way, customary regime, and repeated social pattern that functions as obedience.

activation_trace.role: Habitual condition and accustomed practice expand religion into the patterned order by which life is actually run.
Ascendance now operates over embedded practices and institutions, not only over verbal confessions.
Total enclosure prevents the target field from shrinking to a few formally named communities.

changed_reading.before: The comparison concerns a finite list of religions.
changed_reading.after: The comparison may include every habitual order that organizes allegiance, conduct, judgment, and social life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وكفى بالله شهيدا, especially the split mapping supplied for ك ف ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant sufficiency branch says the witness completes what is needed; the supplied ك ف ف mapping adds withholding. Together they tentatively make divine sufficiency a limit on an unlimited human proof or enforcement project.

activation_trace.role: Adequately carrying an undertaking to completion supplies the primary sense that God's witness meets the need.
The non-dominant withholding branch introduces a possible limiting function: sufficiency can stop excess action.
Decisive declaration supplies the proof that is complete without requiring universal human corroboration.

changed_reading.before: God is merely an additional witness to an outcome humans must establish without limit.
changed_reading.after: God's witness may both complete the proof and restrain the human demand to force or endlessly certify that proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names its decisive event through opening and clarification. Those branches make the disclosure pole of يظهر operational: victory opens a closed field and makes what was occluded distinguishable.

activation_trace.role: An obstruction opening into a widened entrance supplies the event-form through which manifestation can occur.
Becoming apparent after separation makes the opening explicitly revelatory rather than only territorial.
Clarification by speech or sign gives the victory an intelligible, communicative surface.
The focus emergence branch receives the earlier opening as its concrete contextual mechanism.

structural_cues: The opening ayah predicates the event with a doubled opening root and then qualifies it as manifest or clarifying.
The focus purpose clause later reuses a root whose branch inventory also joins appearance to outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening plus clarification and later disclosure plus superiority; I infer that the opening is one mechanism of manifestation, while a primarily military opening remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Prevailing is chiefly the displacement of rivals.
changed_reading.after: Prevailing begins by opening what was closed and rendering the true order publicly distinguishable; displacement remains possible but is not the only mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier commission explicitly sends the addressee as a witness; the focus sends the messenger with guidance and closes with God as sufficient witness. This forms a relay of attestation with a divine terminus.

activation_trace.role: The dispatched carrier role is explicitly joined to witnessing, establishing testimony as part of the mission itself.
Knowledgeable declaration names the messenger's contextual office and supplies the first link in the attestive relay.
The same carrier branch identifies the focus messenger as the commissioned bearer rather than a self-authorizing victor.
Divine declaration closes and underwrites the messenger's witness even before every audience assents.

structural_cues: 48:8 has the compact sequence sending then witness; 48:28 repeats sending and places sufficient witness at the end.
The two commissions frame the intervening surah as evidence carried by the messenger's mission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two mirrored sending-witness configurations; I infer a commissioned witness underwritten by an ultimate witness, while coordination rather than hierarchy between the two witnesses remains possible.

changed_reading.before: God's witness is a closing endorsement added after the messenger's task.
changed_reading.after: Witness-bearing is internal to the sent mission, and God's sufficient witness gives that testimony standing independent of universal recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene turns allegiance into a transaction-like covenant that can be broken or fulfilled. It activates the account, debt, entitlement, and witness branches in the focus as enacted relations rather than remote metaphors.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience gives the focus دين a concrete covenantal transaction and a transfer of allegiance.
Undoing a firmly made covenant supplies the default event whose liability falls back on the breaker.
Completion without deficiency supplies the opposite outcome: the obligation is fully discharged.
A preserved compact protected by trust makes the social bond durable and answerable.
Accounting and recompense receive an enacted covenant whose fulfillment or breach can be judged.
A fixed obligation characterizes the pledged order as due and binding, not merely preferred.

structural_cues: The pledge is syntactically transferred from pledging the messenger to pledging God.
Breach harms the breacher, whereas fulfillment receives recompense, giving the covenant an explicit account structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, breach, fulfillment, and recompense; I infer that these enact the focus's account and obligation branches, while a purely political oath remains a narrower alternative.

changed_reading.before: The religion of truth is chiefly a body of correct teaching.
changed_reading.after: It is also a pledged order of due allegiance whose obligations, breaches, and fulfillment become openly adjudicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly separates what tongues say from what hearts contain. That contrast prevents manifestation from collapsing into public profession: true ظهور must disclose or transform the inner core as well as produce outward speech.

activation_trace.role: The speaking organ supplies an outward verbal surface that can claim more than the speaker inwardly holds.
The heart supplies the concealed interior against which the truth of the public utterance is tested.
The inner core sharpens the contrast from two body parts into surface speech versus the essential center.
Disclosure now has to expose genuine allegiance rather than count a merely visible declaration as success.
The supplied heart-and-unseen branch lets the focus verb reach remembered or concealed interiority, not only exterior display.

structural_cues: 48:11 makes the mismatch explicit with a negated relation between tongue speech and heart content.
The focus asks for comprehensive manifestation, creating pressure against an exterior-only metric.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit surface-interior mismatch; I infer that it calibrates what counts as manifestation, while it could alternatively remain only a diagnosis of the laggards in 48:11.

changed_reading.before: Public profession or visible institutional success adequately realizes manifestation.
changed_reading.after: A manifestation of the true order must make outward speech answerable to the heart's actual allegiance; a verbal facade is counter-evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A contextual alternative of fighting or yielding gives the superiority branch a concrete political-martial realization. This model remains live rather than being dissolved into visibility or inward transformation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies an explicit coercive arena in which opposed allegiances can be contested.
Handing over or relinquishing supplies the noncombat endpoint of submission in the stated alternative.
Superiority over an opponent receives a direct contextual arena and cannot be reduced to private conviction.
Rule and subjection make political dominance one available, though not exhaustive, sense of the focus claim.

structural_cues: 48:16 coordinates combat and yielding as alternative outcomes and then contrasts obedience with turning away.
This occurs before the later scenes where force is deliberately withheld.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies combat and yielding; I infer a martial realization of focus superiority, while peaceful entry into safety or religious submission remains a live alternative for the yielding term.

changed_reading.before: Superiority is only epistemic visibility or moral influence.
changed_reading.after: One coexisting realization is concrete political-martial ascendancy in which opposition fights, yields, or transfers allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet twice makes withheld hands a divine sign and then explains that unrecognized believers could have been trampled unless populations were distinguished. This activates the split restraint branch inside focus كفى and constrains universal supremacy by discriminating protection.

activation_trace.role: Active withholding of others' force is made a sign, so restraint itself becomes evidence of guidance and capacity.
Mutual force is withheld after victory becomes possible, making nonexercise of power part of the victory mechanism.
Literal hands identify both parties' embodied agency as the object of reciprocal restraint.
Crushing pressure supplies the unrealized harm that indiscriminate advance would have inflicted on hidden believers.
Separation and discrimination supply the missing condition under which punitive force could avoid concealed innocents.
The focus split mapping now receives repeated contextual confirmation: sufficient divine witness can function through withholding.
Superiority remains live, but its exercise is limited by the packet's own protection and discrimination mechanism.
The total horizon is prevented from becoming indiscriminate treatment of every person within that horizon.

structural_cues: 48:20 calls withheld hands a sign and immediately joins it to guidance on a straight path.
48:24 places withholding after granted victory, and 48:25 supplies the hidden-person counterfactual that explains restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld force after advantage and a risk to unrecognized believers; I infer that these constrain the means of universal manifestation, while a local tactical delay rather than a general constraint remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Universal superiority naturally implies maximizing available coercive power.
changed_reading.after: Divine sufficiency can manifest precisely by withholding available force, distinguishing hidden persons, and delaying victory rather than trampling the field it claims to order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes heated group zeal to tranquility, then binds the believers to a protective word and calls them more entitled and fitted to it. دين الحق becomes disciplined adherence to a rightful word, not mere possession of a triumphant identity.

activation_trace.role: Binding something by judgment makes the word an adhered-to discipline rather than a passing utterance.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the articulated norm to which the community is bound.
Protection from harm gives the bound word a restraining and preservative purpose against heated excess.
Entitlement and fitness identify who is properly answerable to the word, activating truth as due obligation.
Practiced obedience converts the bound word into a lived order rather than an identity claim.
The focus obligation branch receives a contextual model of rightful adherence opposed to zealotry.

structural_cues: 48:26 contrasts the heat of ignorance with descended tranquility before introducing the binding word.
The same ayah joins entitlement to being the word's proper people and ends with comprehensive divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies zealotry, tranquility, binding, protection, and entitlement; I infer that these specify the ethical texture of دين الحق, while the word could alternatively be one obligation within a broader order.

changed_reading.before: Truth-order prevails because its adherents possess the winning group identity.
changed_reading.after: Truth-order appears in being quietly bound to a protective, intelligible word for which its people prove fitting, against the heat of identity zeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dream is declared truthfully fulfilled, yet a nearer opening precedes the promised entry. The sequence makes divine witnessing temporal and testable: partial openings can attest a larger manifestation before its horizon is complete.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilling a promise in action converts a prior representation into publicly checkable event.
The dream supplies a concealed anticipatory image whose later realization can function as evidence.
Correspondence with what proves real gives the vision's fulfillment the quality of truth rather than coincidence.
A beginning that opens what follows supplies an intermediate realization without exhausting the promised endpoint.
A sign that attests a condition lets the nearer event witness to a larger still-unfolding purpose.
Manifestation becomes staged emergence whose first visible instances can verify the promised whole.

structural_cues: 48:27 distinguishes the promised secure entry from another, nearer opening placed before it.
The focus follows immediately with the larger purpose and a sufficiency-of-witness closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fulfilled vision, an intermediate opening, and then the universal purpose; I infer staged evidentiary fulfillment, while the nearer opening could be only a separate benefit rather than a pledge of the larger outcome.

changed_reading.before: The universal manifestation is an all-at-once future result that lacks evidence until complete.
changed_reading.after: It can unfold through partial, fulfilled signs whose correspondence to prior promise already witnesses the direction of the larger process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant analogy supplies an explicit causal sequence: seed growth, emergence from hiding, lateral shoots, mutual support, thickening, and stable uprightness. Read back into the focus, sending initiates a distributed growth process whose visibility and ascendancy arise internally through supported multiplication.

activation_trace.role: An expressly posed analogy authorizes the plant sequence as a model rather than an accidental lexical cluster.
Germination and cultivation supply a temporally extended mode of increase rather than an instantaneous takeover.
Bringing what was hidden outward directly materializes the disclosure sense of focus manifestation.
New shoots around an origin turn expansion into plural growth that remains related to its source.
Plant parts strengthening one another supplies mutual support as the arrow from fragile emergence to durability.
Thickness after thinness marks accumulated strength without importing harsh conduct from another branch.
Rising into stable position supplies the mature plant's achieved upright visibility.
Load-bearing stems provide the material support on which the now-visible growth stands.
Dispatch and release become the initiating act that lets the growth process move beyond its source.
Emergence from concealment names the same transition that the shoot sequence renders materially.
Height and prevailing remain present as the mature result of growth rather than only an externally imposed relation.

structural_cues: 48:29 immediately follows the focus and gives a tightly ordered verbal chain from emergence to upright stability.
The analogy describes a plural community arising around an origin, not a solitary object merely enlarged from outside.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit plant sequence for the messenger's companions; I infer that it also models how the preceding purpose becomes visible and strong, while the analogy may alternatively describe only community formation and not الدين itself.

changed_reading.before: The true order becomes dominant mainly through top-down displacement of competitors.
changed_reading.after: Its manifestation can be organic and distributed: sending releases a growth that emerges, branches, mutually supports itself, thickens, and finally stands visibly strong.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible marks on faces caused by prostration turn the focus's manifestation and witness language into embodied evidence. The true order is recognizable in durable effects on persons, not only in territorial reach or verbal proclamation.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies an inspectable sign by which an inward practice becomes publicly known.
The second supplied mapping independently retains recognition by a sign, so the activation does not collapse the split root.
The face standing for the person locates the sign on publicly encountered identity rather than on an abstract institution.
A lasting trace indicating what occurred supplies the causal residue by which devotion bears witness.
An attesting sign connects the visible trace to the focus's closing witness rather than treating it as decoration.
Public appearance becomes the embodied legibility of practiced allegiance.

structural_cues: The sign is grammatically located on faces and causally related to an effect of prostration.
This embodied sign precedes the plant analogy, joining personal trace to collective growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible personal marks caused by worship; I infer that these instantiate the focus's manifestation and witness, while the marks may alternatively be one local description rather than a general mode of prevalence.

changed_reading.before: Manifestation is measured mainly by public institutions, territory, or explicit proclamation.
changed_reading.after: The true order also manifests as durable, recognizable effects of practice borne by persons who become signs witnessing to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary guidance is not a sacrificial animal, but the packet gives the focus root an offering-to-the-sanctuary branch and places an explicit blocked offering nearby with the same root and an unrealized destination. It remains anchored to بالهدى and should be rendered only as a processional or entrusted-gift resonance, never as a replacement for guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بالهدى at 48:28, activated by the nearby الهدي that is prevented from reaching its appointed place.

activation_trace.role: The focus root's consecrated-offering branch lets guidance carry a contained resonance of something entrusted and borne toward a sacred destination.
The nearby literal offering activates the same branch and supplies temporary obstruction without cancellation of purpose.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the delayed destination structure that turns obstruction into deferred reaching.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only information or route-direction carried by the messenger.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may additionally resonate as an entrusted offering carried toward manifestation: it can be obstructed en route without losing its consecrated destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for the focus root. It remains packet-valid and gains a contextual bridge from the opening of what was closed, but downstream prose must label it as a split-root acoustic-structural activation, not a lexical gloss of الهدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The supplied split mapping for ه د ي at بالهدى, linked back to the focus purpose of bringing truth out.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking or demolition supplies the strange possibility that guidance disrupts hardened enclosures before truth can emerge.
A closed barrier opening into access provides the contextual bridge from disruptive breaking to a productive aperture.
Emergence from concealment supplies the focus-anchored result and keeps breaking subordinate to disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance operates only by gentle indication within already open structures.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root activation, guidance may also break a hardened enclosure so that the true order can come into view.

strongest_changes: The opening vocabulary makes victory a disclosure event as well as superiority.
The pledge scene turns دين الحق into a due covenant whose breach and fulfillment are judged.
Repeatedly withheld hands and protected hidden believers constrain supremacy by restraint and discrimination.
The final plant sequence recasts manifestation as distributed emergence, mutual support, thickening, and stable growth.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held several mechanisms at once instead of resolving them: attested transmission, juridical obligation, martial ascendancy, restrained power, inward-outward verification, staged fulfillment, embodied signs, and organic growth. The nearby blocked offering also activated a surprising but anchored processional resonance in guidance.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative weight of disclosure and dominance in يظهر remains intentionally unresolved.
The martial submission scene and the later withheld-hands scenes support different calibrations of how superiority is enacted.
The 48:29 plant analogy may model the preceding purpose itself or only the community produced by that purpose.
The offering and ه د د split-root readings are live exploratory resonances, not lexical replacements for guidance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Manifestation and dominance remain concurrent.** `ليظهره` anchors ظ ه ر B001 (coming into view) and B007 (being over/overcoming). `على` structurally supports superiority, while the surah’s signs, clarified opening, and visible embodied marks support disclosure. I infer two distinct mechanisms: truth may prevail by being made evident, and it may be placed above competing orders. The packet does not require choosing between epistemic manifestation and social dominance.
2. **Religion as obedience and reckoning.** Repeated `الدين` anchors د ي ن B001 (obedience/submission), B002 (reckoning/recompense), and B005 (habit/customary state); `الحق` anchors ح ق ق B001. Under B001/B005, the sent guidance reorders lived systems of allegiance; under B002, it makes the true consequence-system prevail. These readings coexist rather than merge. The whole surah’s pledges, acts, and returns activate both.
3. **Sufficient witness closes the evidentiary chain.** `شهيدًا` anchors ش ه د B001/B002/B008; `كفى` anchors ك ف ي B001/B002, sufficing by taking care of a matter. I infer that divine witness supplies enough presence, knowledge, and sign to establish the claim even before all outcomes appear. The closing is evidentiary sufficiency, not a decorative formula.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:29 answers the witness claim with visible communal evidence: faces bear traces and the crop stands upright through mutual support. Manifestation and testimony converge without collapsing the distinct dominance reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Manifestation as becoming inspectably visible.** Fixed `لِيُظْهِرَهُ` anchors ظ ه ر `B001`, coming out into view. Ayah 48:27 moves from dream vision to bodily entry, and 48:29 supplies visible faces, a remaining trace, and a shoot emerging into mature growth. The packet supplies successive modes of appearance; I infer **guidance enacted -> truth takes observable social and bodily form**. On this retained reading, the aim is disclosure and inspectability, not dominance.

2. **Manifestation as prevailing over a field.** The same fixed form independently activates ظ ه ر `B007`, being over or overcoming, sharpened by fixed `عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ`. Ayat 48:24-27 show capacity to prevail, strategic restraint, delayed sorting, and a nearer opening. Those are packet-supplied stages; I infer **controlled sequence of openings -> eventual superior reach across the whole field**. This is a distinct dominance reading and is not merged with visibility into a compromise.

3. **Religion as practiced and recompensed order.** Fixed doubled د ي ن activates `B001` (obedience and submission), `B002` (reckoning and recompense), and `B005` (habitual state). Ayah 48:29 immediately combines prostration, seeking bounty and approval, cultivated collective form, righteous work, forgiveness, and reward. The packet supplies practice and recompense around the fixed noun; I infer **repeated obedient conduct -> settled social habit -> accountable outcome**. `دِينِ ٱلْحَقّ` reads as an enacted economy, not an abstract title alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 48:29 decisively separated the two retained ظ ه ر readings: visible marks and emerging shoots activate coming-into-view, while thickening and standing upright activate effective prevalence. Its action-and-recompense sequence also made fixed `دين` legible as practiced order.

baseline.text: Elçisini doğru yol ve hak dinle gönderen O'dur; böylece onu bütün dinlere üstün kılsın. Tanık olarak Allah yeter.

findings.text: Hak dinin üstün gelmesi, egemenliğin yanında, doğru yolun davranışlarda ve toplumsal biçimde denetlenebilir ölçüde görünür hâle gelmesi anlamını da taşır.
Din, yalnızca bir ad değil, tekrar edilen itaatin toplumsal alışkanlığa dönüştüğü ve karşılığının görüldüğü yaşanan bir düzendir.
Allah'ın yeterli tanıklığı, bütün sonuçlar henüz görünmeden önce de iddiayı hazır bulunuş, bilgi ve işaretle kanıtlayacak yeterliliktedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Dalın somut çekirdeği hayvandan elde edilen süttür.
Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın süt maddesini ve özellikle belirtilen ardışık akış niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sütü, bolluğunu ve sürekli akışını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesi uzantısını doğrudan adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Maddenin kendisi kastedildiğinde en yalın doğal karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun hayvanları süt vermeye başladığında kullanılan yapıyı açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, birine veya bir şeye ısınıp yanında rahatça açılmayı kapsar; yavaş okuma veya genel gönderme anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, birine ya da bir şeye yönelmeyi belirten yapılarla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir yakınlık anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye veya şeye içten yönelip yabancılık duymamak; ona güvenerek yanında rahatlamak ve kendini çekinmeden açmaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin iç yönelişi, yabancılıktan yakınlık ve güvene geçiş oluşturur.
Bu güvenin görünür sonucu, karşısındakinin yanında rahat ve açık davranmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin birine veya bir şeye içten yönelmesini; onun yanında güven, yakınlık, rahatlık ve açıklık kazanmasını ortak biçimde anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, karşılıklı iletişim ve ortak uğraşta eşlik edip izlemeyi kapsar; tek yönlü gönderiyi veya yalnızca taşınan iletiyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklı haberleşme, yarışma eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte izleme biçimlerini kendi yapılara bağlı tutar; yalın köke genel arkadaşlık anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: İki kişinin karşılıklı haberleşmesi veya ortak bir uğraşta birbirine ayak uydurması; özellikle atışma gibi bir işte yanında durması ya da şarkı ve çalışmada öncekinin ardından gitmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki taraf arasında karşılıklı gönderim veya birinin ötekini izlemesiyle kurulan eşgüdümdür.
Atışma veya başka bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran ve onunla birlikte ilerleyen eşlikçi kastedilebilir.
Şarkı veya işte bir öncekinin sesini ya da eylemini izleyerek sürdüren kişi kastedilebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, eşi ölmüş veya kendisinden ayrılmış kadını ve ayrılığın yaklaştığını sezen kadını, taliplerin kendisine evlenme önerisi iletmesi bakımından birleştirir. Çerçeve hem gerçekleşmiş hem beklenen ayrılık koşulunu açıkça korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bu kadın durumuna ve taliplerin ileti kurmasına bağlıdır; genel haberleşmeyi veya bütün dul kadınları koşulsuz biçimde kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kullanımda sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahatlığı, başka bir kullanımda ise bir şeyi içten ve isteyerek vermeyi gösterir. Çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak gönüllü veriş rahatlık çekirdeğinin bağımsız eş anlamlısı değil, belirli verme bağlamındaki uzantısı olarak tutulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Temel karşıtlık, sıkıntılı ve sert durum karşısındaki rahatlık ve ferahlıktır.
Verme bağlamında rahatlık, isteksizlik veya zorlama olmadan gönülden vermek olarak gerçekleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.
